title: Mail sent without transport encryption (python)
description: python code constructs a mail client without an encrypted transport (smtplib.SMTP). Credentials for the relay and the body of every message — often a password reset link — cross the network in clear text. This lexical rule flags the client; the reviewer confirms STARTTLS or implicit TLS is configured.
remediation: Use SMTP over TLS with certificate verification, for example smtplib.SMTP_SSL with a verified context, and refuse to send when the server does not offer it.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: flags the constructor even when STARTTLS is issued immediately afterwards.
